metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-8037: Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.. Product: LoadMaster
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "CVE-2026-8037" or Message contains "LOADMASTER" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), clientIp_s | where count_ > 3
